english.note: Use this pattern when specifying that someone is spanked with a paddle, with A as 槳 and B as 屁股.

examples.english: When I was little, my mum once used a paddle to spank my bottom.
examples.traditional: 細個嗰陣，阿媽試過用槳打我個屁股。
